title: DIROXIMEL FUMARATE TO REDUCE PERIHAEMATOMAL OEDEMA IN INTRACEREBRAL HAEMORRHAGE: A DOUBLE BLIND RANDOMIZED CLINICAL TRIAL
official: DIROXIMEL FUMARATE TO REDUCE PERIHAEMATOMAL OEDEMA IN INTRACEREBRAL HAEMORRHAGE: A DOUBLE BLIND RANDOMIZED CLINICAL TRIAL (DARLENE)
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate the efficacy of Diroximel Fumarate (DRF) as compared with placebo in reducing Peri-Haematoma Oedema (PHO) at day 8 in patients with spontaneous intracerebral haemorrhage (ICH).
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Patients 18 years or older (no upper age limit)
2. Patients admitted for a first-ever or recurrent symptomatic supratentorial spontaneous ICH confirmed by brain imaging
3. Administration of study treatment no later than 48 hours after symptom  onset or since last seen without neurological deficit
4. Written consent obtained
5. Patient with social insurance in France
6. Patient willing to comply with all study procedures and duration
Exclusion criteria:
1. Massive ICH for Investigational medicinal product seems futile (hematoma volume is estimated > 60ml)
2. Patients unable to swallow
3. Severe pre-ICH dependency (modified Rankin score of 5)
4. Life expectancy < 1 year related to comorbidities
5. Late-stage organ (acute cardiac, renal or hepatic failure)
6. Decision already taken for palliative (end of life) care with withdrawal of active treatment
7. Pregnancy or breastfeeding or Women of childbearing age without effective contraception (a pregnancy test will be done)
8. Adults who are deprived of their liberty by judicial or administrative decision
9. Severe coma (Glasgow Coma Scale <6)
10. Pure intraventricular hemorrhage
11. ICH suspected to result from a preceding trauma, an identified intracranial vascular malformation, venous thrombosis, tumor or hemorrhagic transformation within an infarct
12. Patient planned for surgical evacuation of ICH (Evacuation, Decompressive hemicraniectomy, External ventricular drain)
13. Patient with a known indication for DRF treatment (e.g. multiple sclerosis) or any other NrF2 agonist (dimethyl fumarate; Tecfidera)
14. Patient with contraindication to DRF: patients with known hypersensitivity to DRF, or to any of the excipients of VUMERITY; patients taking dimethyl fumarate)
15. Severe lymphopenia at admission (lymphocyte counts < 0.5 x 109/L)
16. Medical history of progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy
